paper_figures6_7_comparison.policy: Figure6 uses fixed source case identity; compare only ordinate reading bounds, never interpolate predictions against measured x. Correlation stars use source eq55 and measured film flow separately from model dots. Figure7 propagates both coordinate and ordinate reading bounds. Failed/nonconverged native statuses remain explicit; no tolerance or experimental acceptance claim.
